description: Create a Daydream cloud-hosted StreamDiffusion bridge in TD. A webclientDAT POSTs the encoded source TOP frame to Daydream's REST endpoint; the diffused result is pulled back via a Syphon/Spout/NDI receiver and exposed as a null TOP. API key is read from DAYDREAM_API_KEY in the TD process environment — never inlined. Live probe SKIPPED (requires Daydream account + outbound HTTPS).

active.description: Start polling immediately (default off so artist can confirm API key is set).

expose_controls.description: Add custom-page sliders (Prompt, Strength, FPS, Active).

fps.description: Outbound POST cadence; clamped 1–30 (cloud rate-limit guard).

output_mode.description: Receiver TOP to instantiate for the relay output.

output_source_name.description: NDI source / Syphon-Spout sender name to subscribe to.

parent_path.description: COMP to create the bridge sub-network in.

prompt.description: Text prompt sent in the request body.

server_url.description: Daydream inference endpoint. Override for self-hosted or staging.

source_top_path.description: TOP whose frames are POSTed to Daydream.

name: connect_daydream_cloud
title: Connect Daydream Cloud
